task_text: Run the track: move forward 29 m along it to the finish (MyoChallenge 2024 OSL Run, its own win condition), staying within 1 m of the track's centre line and on your feet; the right leg is the prosthesis (`osl_knee_angle_r`, `osl_ankle_angle_r`), driven by its own controller, so you command only the 54 muscles. Failure (the episode ends): falling, leaving the track sideways, or moving 2 m backwards. There is no time limit.
